up: List all approved drugs (max_phase = 4) whose mechanism of action is classified as MODULATOR. For each drug, include the drug name (pref_name), ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), canonical SMILES, mechanism description, target ChEMBL ID (target_chembl_id), and target preferred name (target_pref_name).
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.pref_name,
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  dm.mechanism_of_action,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_pref_name
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON dm.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE md.max_phase = 4
  AND dm.action_type = 'MODULATOR';
